answer: ZipException: Not avoided (though unlikely given valid entry names and no duplicates, the condition is not explicitly prevented). IOException: Not avoided (no checks or handling to prevent I/O errors from the underlying stream).
remark: ZipException can be triggered if a ZIP format error occurs, such as an invalid entry name (unlikely here) or a duplicate entry (names are distinct). It may also arise from internal ZIP writing issues. IOException can be triggered by any I/O failure on the underlying OutputStream, such as the stream being closed prematurely, a disk full error, or network failure if the stream is network-based.
